blocks.text: Is technique mein gene of interest ki bohat si bilkul aik jaisi copies banayi jati hain. Copy banane ke liye enzyme DNA polymerase istemal hota hai jo DNA ke diye gaye tukre ko baar baar polymerize karta hai (us ki nayi strand banata hai), taa ke bohat si copies ban jayen. Isi liye is technique ko polymerase chain reaction (PCR) kehte hain. Kary Mullis ne 1983 mein PCR ijaad ki aur 1993 mein unhein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.prompt: Is amal ko 'chain' reaction kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke har cycle mein bani copies agli cycle mein template ban jati hain; is tarah copy ka amal zanjeer (chain) ki tarah baar baar chalta hai aur copies dugni hoti jati hain.

items: PCR: DNA polymerase se gene of interest ki baar baar copy kar ke bohat si aik jaisi copies banana.
Kary Mullis ne 1983 mein PCR banayi; 1993 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize.
